name: Feature Request

title: "[FEATURE] "

---

## Problem

Describe the problem you are trying to solve. What are you unable to do today?
(e.g. "I can't easily find which episodes I haven't watched yet across multiple shows.")

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you would like. Be as specific as you can.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you tried any workarounds? Are there other ways this could be solved?

## Additional Context

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar features in other apps, or any other
context that would help us understand the request.
